fatal_blockers: Proposal 1 has no polynomial-size linear realization of the global Barrington–Magnus word. Fixed-degree truncation is covered by O1, while degree high enough to outrun growing cubes has an exponential coefficient dictionary; representing whole assignment words invokes O6, and circuit linearization invokes O2/O5. The degree-4 all-eight test cannot discriminate this asymptotic dichotomy.

Proposal 2 specifies neither a frozen hitting set, evaluation matrix, field-to-binary map, nor output bound. ROABP hitting sets preserve nonzeroness, not the number of nonzero binary coordinates needed for a Hamming gap, and bounded derivative orders remain vulnerable to O1 where suitable cubes exist. Finite YES/NO testing cannot resolve the missing support theorem or polynomial-width requirement.

Proposal 3 is defeated by affine closure independently of Witt depth. Each ghost coordinate shown is linear in the integer coefficients, so if every legal matching has one common target, every odd affine combination of legal matchings has that target at every level; known illegal covers therefore incur no carry discrepancy. Coordinate scaling cannot repair an exact zero discrepancy, and introducing carry slacks invokes O5.

Proposal 4 gives no canonical polynomial-time divisor assignment or CVP matrix. Linear equivalence preserves divisor degree, so the stated 'minimum effective degree within a divisor class' is not a varying metric unless an additional nonlinear chip-addition objective is defined; Baker–Norine gonality alone supplies no Euclidean or binary syndrome lower bound. Searching graph/divisor assignments on tiny instances could overfit known witnesses and would not test an arbitrary-instance reduction.

Proposal 5's two-coset OR identity is correct, but it does not address the blocker claimed by the proposal. Full Shannon expansion has exponential rank, and no shared-substructure compilation is specified whose consistency could be attacked; the three-variable experiment merely verifies a constant-size instance of an already exact identity. O1–O6 remain untouched inside the leaves, so this is not a genuinely discriminating experiment for polynomial compilation.

Proposal 6 lacks the required binary linearization preserving word order and filling area. Relator-count lattices abelianize diagrams and lose the proposed nonabelian invariant, while enforcing ordered van Kampen diagrams through bounded local cells re-enters O2; enumerating diagrams only through area 12 cannot certify minima beyond that bound. A Baumslag–Solitar toy chosen after seeing hostile words also supplies no arbitrary-SAT construction or polynomial output theorem.
evidence: The exchange-quotient verifier found 32 instances where an illegal odd cover lies in the affine span of perfect matchings, with examples of weight 5 versus legal weight 3. This directly kills Proposal 3's common linear ghost target and any analogous common legal class.

O1 proves an exact alternating cube relation for every bounded-degree signature whenever the corresponding independent cube exists. Dense postprocessing, modular reduction, and tensoring do not remove that relation, so degree-4 Magnus or bounded-derivative tests cannot establish an asymptotic escape.

Prior dense condenser experiments preserved nonzeroness yet flattened support: the five-block F8 test had worst YES 31 and best NO 6 without pointed kernels. This is direct finite evidence that PIT/rank preservation does not imply the Hamming separation asserted by Proposal 2.

The supplied tensor and compression verifiers repeatedly show that exact mixed-word mechanisms do not solve output-rank accounting: reduced tensoring amplifies distance but grows length, while exact type simplification is rigorously vacuous on the BMT family. Proposal 5 provides no new compression mechanism beyond an exponential decision tree.

O8 transfers only an already-correct binary syndrome distance to Euclidean CVP. It does not furnish the missing binary realizations for divisor effectivity or nonabelian filling area, and no supplied verifier establishes such a realization.
next_experiment: None for these formulations. Reconsider only a mutation that supplies one explicit witness-oblivious polynomial-time matrix or integer basis, fixed target, polynomial rank bound, universal YES-cost bound, and all-mixed-word soundness invariant; its precommitted test must include all-eight, odd holonomy, affine-closure covers, exact minima, and output-rank accounting.
